name: Brimstone Hill Fortress National Park
description: Perched on a steep volcanic hill above St. Kitts' western coast, Brimstone Hill is a sprawling British fortress of thick stone walls, cannon-lined batteries and old barracks. Enslaved Africans built it during the 17th and 18th centuries. It is among the best-preserved forts in the Americas, and from the ramparts you can look out over the Caribbean Sea and neighbouring islands.
